messages:
Ana: FYI sales pushed a block of bespoke customers that want to be mapped to our 2025 standard tiers before EOM. Need a defensible migration policy and minimal runtime changes.
Ben: Quick ask from two customers: keep current burst credits and priority routing for 9-12 months. Some contracts mention these explicitly.
Claire: Legal, can you confirm which phrases force us to preserve behavior vs which are merely commercial descriptions?
LegalBot: If contract text contains exact terms like "burst credits" or "priority routing" or references an SLA appendix, those are binding. Generic statements about "best effort" are not.
Diego: Implementation thought: add tenant flag legacy_tier_profile and a simple mapper service. Serving will honor legacy caps + routing labels when flag present. Billing will tag requests with billing_tag=legacy.
Ana: Operational constraints: we must avoid doubling production code paths long-term. Plan a timebox for the legacy path (e.g., 12 months) and require explicit extension per-account with Legal + RevOps signoff.
Ben: Sales wants a playbook and email template. Also need a clear escalation for >12mo extensions: Sales -> RevOps -> Legal -> CRO.
Claire: Deliverable from Legal: list of enforceable customers and a short memo with sample language we must obey.
Diego: Tech effort: mapper + flag + billing tag = 2 sprints; e2e tests + dashboard filters = 1 sprint. Pilot of 4 accounts recommended.
Ana: Launch gates: (1) Legal memo, (2) Sales playbook + templates, (3) runtime flag + mapper + QA, (4) telemetry fields: tenant_id, legacy_profile, migration_ts, sla_preserved boolean, (5) pilot success and rollback plan.
Ben: Finance/RevOps: will there be pro-rated credits if new tier is cheaper? Product won't assume credits; flagging for decision.
Claire: I'll surface contract hits by Thursday and tag accounts as enforceable/negotiable/opt-in.
Diego: I'll post RFC with mapper API and rollback steps in #eng-runtime by Friday.
Ana: Action items recap: Claire - contract list; Ben - pilot outreach and templates; Diego - RFC + impl ETA; Legal - memo; I'll coordinate pilot signups. Sync next Tue for signoff.
